 Coram:

The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Aditya Kumar
 Mohapatra
 Order
06.08.2025 Order No.
02. I.A. No.2029 of 2025
1.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid mode.
2. This interlocutory application has been filed seeking modification of order dated 15.07.2025.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the Petitioner inadvertently the wrong offences have been typed out by typing the final order.
It has been mentioned "under Sections 457, 380, 34 of IPC" in Para-4 of the said order instead of "under Sections 294, 420, 376(2)(n), 34 of IPC".
Accordingly, it may be corrected.

4. Considering such submission, this Court modifies the order dated 15.07.2025 to the extent that the expressions "under Sections 457, 380, 34 of IPC" occurred in Para-4 be corrected as "under Sections 294, 420, 376(2)(n), 34 of IPC".
5.
In view of the aforesaid modification, the time is extended by a further period of four weeks from today.
